metadata.title: Tribal Food । आदिवासी खाना | Punbahan Chakhoi | #adivasifood #tribalfood #foodie #food #muttoncurry
metadata.description: Punhahan Chakoi is a delicacy of tribes in Tripura. It means mutton curry and this dish is cooked with indigenous ingredients and special green chilly of Tripura. Rice powder is used to give body to this dish. Watch how people of the Kalai tribe.
